name: paw-mascot
description: A mascot on your desktop that reacts while Claude works.

scripts.sync-fx: if [ -d ../paw-fx/effects/paw-avatar ]; then cp ../paw-fx/effects/paw-avatar/index.js ../paw-fx/effects/paw-avatar/style.css web/_fx/effects/paw-avatar/ && echo 'synced from ../paw-fx'; else echo 'no ../paw-fx checkout - keeping the vendored copy'; fi
scripts.sync-bridge: cp skills/paw-mascot/scripts/paw-event.sh plugin/hooks/paw-event.sh && chmod +x plugin/hooks/paw-event.sh && echo 'plugin bridge synced from skills/'
